tasks.title: Task 2.1 - Calculate the population density of sites near Ataturk urban forest
tasks.statement: Map 1. Four neighbourhoods near the Ataturk urban forest, Table 1. Some information about the four neighbourhoods (Tarabya, Maslak, Camlitepe, Ferahevler - total population, young/middle-aged/elderly ratio, persons per household), and Map 2. Location of the three sites for calculation. For Site 1, Site 2, and Site 3, find the estimated site area, estimated population, and estimated population density of each site based on the provided housing types, floors, and family numbers per floor.

parts.question: Write your answers in the table on the response sheet for Site 1, Site 2, and Site 3: A. Estimated site area, B. Estimated population, C. Estimated population density of this site.

tasks.title: Task 2.2 - Accessibility near Ataturk urban forest
tasks.statement: Map 3 – Transport infrastructure and network near Ataturk urban forest. Draw 3 polygons onto the Map shown in the response sheet. Each polygon should be a size of 800 m x 800 m (square in shape), with the estimated highest, medium and lowest level of accessibility respectively. Label the squares with 1, 2 and 3 respectively for their estimated accessibility. Provide justifications of your answers in the table on the response sheet.

parts.question: A. Polygon number (1, 2, 3), B. Level of accessibility (Highest, Medium, Lowest), C. Justifications.

tasks.title: Task 2.3 - Mapping and annotation
tasks.statement: The satellite image shows the area near Haciosman metro station (the northern terminal of the M2 metro line, opened in 2011 to serve neighbourhoods in Sariyer). Draw a land use map of the highlighted area (the blue rectangle box) shown in the satellite image. The land use map should contain different types of land use in the built-up area and non-built-up area. In addition, you are required A) to classify the residential housing shown in the highlighted area into at least two different types and B) to classify the non-built-up area into two different types. A key and the rationale (reasons for) your classifications should also be provided. Draw your map on the response sheet. The locations, accuracy, size of features, residential housing classification, key and use of symbols will be assessed. Provide your rationale for A) and B) in the response sheet.

parts.question: Draw a land use map, classify residential housing into at least two types, classify non-built-up area into two types, provide a key, use of symbols, and provide rationale for A and B.

tasks.title: Task 2.4 - Decision making
tasks.statement: The local government proposes to have a new housing project in the non-built-up area near the Ataturk urban forest. The possible site of the new housing project is marked as “A” in the satellite image. The area of the site is approximately 25,000 m2. The site is targeted to accommodate 10,000 people after completion.

parts.question: List the locational advantages and disadvantages of this new site of housing project ‘A’. Consider factors related to natural environment and urban development, as well as of different scales (e.g. local and regional if appropriate). A. Natural environment advantages, B. Urban development advantages, C. Natural environment disadvantages, D. Urban development disadvantages.

tasks.title: Task 2.5 - Layout plan
tasks.statement: Design the layout of the new housing project ‘A’ (Area: about 25,000 m2, Target population to be accommodated after completion: 10,000 persons). You have to consider: i) spatial arrangements, ii) building density, iii) height of buildings, iv) types of housing, and v) the target population to be accommodated in the site. In addition, you have to provide some written justifications of your proposed layout design.

parts.question: Provide written justifications of your proposed layout design: A. Site layout, density and height of building, B. Types of housing to be built.
